checks.name: Record shape
checks.description: Required fields present and correctly typed on every species record

checks.name: Cross-references
checks.description: Organisation ids, source ids and country codes all resolve

checks.name: Population figures
checks.description: Ranges bracket their estimate; every figure carries a unit, survey and date

checks.name: Citations
checks.description: Every species rests on at least one primary assessment or national register

checks.name: Staleness
checks.description: Assessments over 12 years old, counts over 8 years old and national listings unconfirmed for 365 days are surfaced

checks.name: Coverage
checks.description: Every continent resolves, and countries without records are accounted for

checks.name: Organisations
checks.description: Every organisation has an https link and a described role; species name three

checks.name: Plate provenance
checks.description: Historical plates carry artist, work, year, licence and source; 205 species have a portrait, 73 have none located
